text:
Elaine S.: Heads-up — infra asked for a 30d export of auth-events-prod for the pentest team. They want KMS-wrapped delivery and a tight TTL. Can we do a timeboxed SIEM export?
Owen K.: @Elaine S. can you confirm consumer identity and exact fields needed? we need RBAC justification before granting export role. Typically we do SSE-KMS + ephemeral bucket via export-proxy. :lock:
Samir P.: Consumer is the external pentest vendor (NDA in ticket). Fields: timestamp, event_type, user_id, src_ip (mask), device_id, auth_result. Need file by EOD. :eyes:
Maria L.: We should follow the JIT export checklist. TTL <= 72h, auto-rotate the KMS grant, scrub PII (emails, full IPs), and require two approvals. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/log-access (see Export checklist section).
Maria L.: Request template (put in the ticket body):
```
- consumer: vendor-name + contact
- justification: vuln triage / pentest
- stream: auth-events-prod
- fields: list + redaction rules
- ttl_hours: 48
- delivery: s3://redwood-ephemeral-exports/<id>.enc (SSE-KMS)
- attachments: NDA, POA
```
audit-bot: Export request created: id=ex-2026-09-01-42, requester=Samir P., approvals=0/2, created=2791234000
Owen K.: I'll start the KMS-wrap flow. Plan: create ephemeral bucket, create kms-grant for export-proxy, and grant siem_exporter role via iam-jit for 12h once approvals hit 2/2. Example grant CLI: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/export-proxy --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey --name ex-2026-09-01-42
```
Owen K.: Also will attach an export ACL so the consumer can only download the final object, not query via Splunk/SIEM API. Proxy will log any download attempts.
Samir P.: Ticket INT-5421 created, NDA attached, included the redaction rules (mask last octet of IPs, remove email). Requested TTL 48h.
Maria L.: Confirming: security will not grant raw query access to the vendor. Only a single encrypted export file delivered to them. We'll run the scrub job post-export and then bucket retention 7 days, after which we auto-delete.
Owen K.: Grant flow set: iam-jit will issue role=siem_exporter to service-account:exporter@infra for duration=12h once PR #234 is merged and approvals are recorded. Audit trail will include grant_id and KMS grant id.
Owen K.: PR #234: adds policy snippet (excerpt):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["s3:PutObject", "s3:GetObject"],
  "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-ephemeral-exports/ex-2026-09-01-42*",
  "Condition": {"Bool": {"aws:SecureTransport": "true"}}
}
```
Maria L.: Also add a proxy ACL to block Splunk API tokens from the consumer IPs. They must authenticate to a one-time download link only.
audit-bot: Approval recorded: approver=Maria L., approvals=1/2
Elaine S.: I'll do the second approval once I validate the ticket attachments. Quick Q: do we log the exact queries used to generate the export for future repro?
Owen K.: Yes — export-proxy writes a query audit artifact to the secure audit-bucket (kms-wrapped) and we retain that artifact for 90 days. The exported data gets 7d ephemeral retention.
oncall-runbook-bot: Reminder: export ex-2026-09-01-42 TTL starts now, expires in 47h 59m. Follow runbook steps to revoke JIT if needed.
audit-bot: Export completed: id=ex-2026-09-01-42, file=s3://redwood-ephemeral-exports/ex-2026-09-01-42.enc, kms_key=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd1234, delivery=vendor-sftp (encrypted), approvals=2/2
Samir P.: Vendor has received the file and confirmed download. I'll verify redaction with them and report back.
Elaine S.: :thumbsup: closing once Samir confirms scrub and we confirm bucket scheduled deletion. Thanks everyone for fast turnaround.
